title: Red Sox Activate Anthony, Story From IL for Yankees Series Finale
dek: The Red Sox activated Roman Anthony and Trevor Story from the injured list ahead of Sunday's series finale against the Yankees. Both players were inserted into the starting lineup immediately, with Anthony batting leadoff as the designated hitter.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Roman Anthony and Trevor Story activated from injured list prior to Sunday's series finale against the Yankees and placed directly into the starting lineup.
bottom_line: Anthony and Story rejoin the Red Sox roster for the final game of the series against New York. The source material does not provide details on the nature or duration of each player's injury or on Story's position in the lineup.
body: The Red Sox activated Roman Anthony and Trevor Story from the injured list prior to Sunday's series finale against the Yankees, per MLB.com. Both players were immediately slotted into the starting lineup, with Anthony batting leadoff as the designated hitter.
The timing places both players back in the lineup for the concluding regular-season matchup against a division rival during the pennant-race stretch run.
